faqs.question: What does W-180 grade mean?
faqs.answer: W-180 is the highest standard in cashew grading, known as the 'King of Cashews'. Only 180 whole kernels make up one pound, guaranteeing the largest size and maximum creaminess.

faqs.question: Are these roasted or raw?
faqs.answer: These are unroasted, raw sun-cured kernels, allowing you to enjoy their natural delicate sweetness or roast them to your liking.
